|game_text=Deploy on an assassin; assassin is power +1. May target a character at same or adjacent site for free. Draw destiny. If destiny +1 > defense value: target hit, may not be captured, and you may place a bounty on target in Used Pile to retrieve 2 Force.
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Assassin's Blaster Rifle]] (version 2 of 4). The image here is the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-D-assassinsblasterrifle-pre.gif]]). The current text is [[Assassin's Blaster Rifle (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3). Each version below is quoted in full with its dated source; differences that come only from a document's medium (icons written out in words on the card list, straight quotes, credit lines) are not changes. How these versions came about (Holotable data, the PC website card list, the Master List and the PC card images) is told in [[PC Legacy Virtual Transcription Error History]].
* '''Original''' ([[Assassin's Blaster Rifle]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 8.2 release sheet (official text as of 14 September 2012)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock8_2">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_2.pdf#page=3 Virtual Block 8.2 release sheet] ("Official text as of September 14, 2012"; the surviving copy was re-made 18 October 2012), page 3, slip 11 (position on the sheet; the slip prints no number). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095520/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_2.pdf#page=3 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Deploy on your assassin; assassin is power +1. May target a character at same or adjacent site for free. Draw destiny. If destiny +1 > defense value: target hit, may not be captured this turn, and you may place a bounty on target in Used Pile to retrieve 2 Force.” The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB8-03-Assassins_Blaster_Rifle.png]]) prints it. The release-sheet slip prints no slip number.
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): The PC website card list (shown there by 12 December 2012 and in the capture of 11 January 2013) changed “Deploy on your assassin” to “Deploy on an assassin” and dropped “this turn” (“may not be captured,”)<ref name="cl-1282_11-2012-12-12">Players Committee website card list (VBlock8Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212003733/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2012-12-12] (Internet Archive); the same text in the capture of 11 January 2013 (the card is not in the capture of 21 July 2012)</ref>: “Deploy on an assassin; assassin is power +1. May target a character at same or adjacent site for free. Draw destiny. If destiny +1 > defense value: target hit, may not be captured, and you may place a bounty on target in Used Pile to retrieve 2 Force.” The card list is a text page: no slip, picture or slip number, and icons are written out in words.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Assassin's Blaster Rifle (Errata 2)]]): The Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Dark Side, p. 58)<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=58, page 58. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=58 Internet Archive]</ref> prints the original printed text again, word for word: “Deploy on your assassin; assassin is power +1. May target a character at same or adjacent site for free. Draw destiny. If destiny +1 > defense value: target hit, may not be captured this turn, and you may place a bounty on target in Used Pile to retrieve 2 Force.” '''What changed:''' “Deploy on your assassin” and “may not be captured this turn” again, for the card list's “Deploy on an assassin” and “may not be captured”. The Master List repeats words published earlier; it is a version of its own because it was published after a different text (Bill, 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat). The PC website card list was generated from the Holotable card data; the Master List went back to the release-sheet words. The Master List slip shows the whole card frame with the picture area left blank; like the slip, it prints no slip number. Like the slip and the card image, it prints the title with two dots (“••Assassin's Blaster Rifle”). In GEMP the Master List wording is the version 2282_2011, which plays as the original.
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Assassin's Blaster Rifle (Errata 3)]]): The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-D-assassinsblasterrifle-pre.gif]]) prints: “Deploy on an assassin; assassin is power +1. May target a character at same or adjacent site for free. Draw destiny. If destiny +1 > defense value: target hit, may not be captured, and you may place a bounty on target in Used Pile to retrieve 2 Force.” '''What changed:''' The card-list words return: “Deploy on an assassin” and “may not be captured” (without “this turn”). The image is undated. The PC's image folder (Virtual8-Dark) lists the file, with every other file in it, as last modified on 7 May 2013<ref name="r6-Virtual8-Dark">[https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034744/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual8-Dark/large/?C=M;O=A Apache directory listing of Virtual8-Dark/large] (Internet Archive, captured 18 August 2019): every file in the folder last modified 7 May 2013; the captures of the image in 2018 and 2019 have the same bytes as the file on the wiki. Research note R6, 11 November 2026.</ref>; it is dated by that upload date, after the Master List (27 April 2013), so it is the latest publication and the current text. The date is a bulk upload of the whole Virtual Block 8 folder, and the image may have been made earlier (it prints the superseded card-list words, so it may date from the card list of 2012), but the wiki orders versions by the date each document was published (Bill, 11 November 2026). It is a version of its own even though its words repeat an earlier text (Bill, 11 November 2026: every publication is a version). The card image is the whole card, with the Decipher picture; like the slip, it prints no slip number. GEMP's current card keeps the card-list wording it already played, so nothing changes in play; the Master List wording is a version of its own.
